claims.exact_statement: For every Boolean seed g on n bits and k>=2 with N=n+k>=3, F(x,z)=g(x)(-1)^{1[wt(x,z)<=1]} has at least three distinct truth-matrix rows on every proper block A with 2<=|A|<=N-1. For every nonconstant g, n>=1 and m>=1, choose N=8(n+m+2),k=N-n: |H(F)-H(g)| and |I(F)-I(g)| are each <=2^-m I(g), and H(F)/I(F)>=(H(g)/I(g)-2^-m)/(1+2^-m). Consequently the extended-real supremum C_prime of H/I over these composition-prime functions equals unrestricted C_FEI. For fixed K>=0 and kappa in R, let A_P=C_P+kappa I+sum_j q_j R_K(g_j) be the specific signed bank over proper disjoint single-output Boolean-core partitions P with true full stopping hulls. Then sup_{nonconstant f,dimension>=2} inf_P A_P(f)/I(f)=C_FEI+kappa. No unbounded seed family is constructed.
